# Descriptions
@@ 1
Subtracts 5 from elemental attack rolls against the target, and adds 5 to all
of the target’s RRs versus spells.
@@ 2
When the caster of this spell is a target of a spell from the realm of
Channeling, the “incoming” spell must first make an RR before the caster makes
an RR. For RR purposes, each spell uses a level equal to its caster’s level.
If the “incoming” spell passes the RR, it may target the caster of this spell
normally; otherwise the incoming spell has no effect on this target.
@@ 3
As Protection I, except for duration and all beings within 10' of target get
the benefits.
@@ 4
As Cancel Channeling, except the caster is protected from spells in the realm
of Essence.
@@ 5
As Protection I, except bonuses are 10.
@@ 6
As Cancel Channeling, except the caster is protected from spells in the realm
of Mentalism.
@@ 7
As Protection Sphere I, except bonuses are 10.
@@ 8
Any active spell from the realm of Channeling that is on the target must make
an RR (use the level of that spell’s caster as the spell’s level). If the
spell fails its RR, it is dispelled.
@@ 9
Creates a shimmering shield in front of the caster. This shield subtracts 10
from all frontal Channeling attack rolls on the caster (base and elemental).
In addition, if the caster performs no other actions during a round, he can
“parry” (as with a normal shield) one spell attack. The parry bonus is equal
to 10 plus the caster’s skill rank with this list.
@@ 10
As Protection I, except bonuses are 15.
@@ 11
As Channeling Shield, except is effective only against Essence spells.
@@ 12
As Dispel Channeling, except effects spells in the realm of Essence.
@@ 13
As Channeling Shield, except is effective only against Mentalism spells.
@@ 14
As Protection I, except bonuses are 20.
@@ 15
As Channeling Shield, except it is effective against two realms of the
caster’s choice.
@@ 16
As Dispel Channeling, except effects spells in the realm of Mentalism.
@@ 17
As Protection I, except bonuses are 25.
@@ 19
As Channeling Shield, except all three realms are affected.
@@ 20
Target gets +50 to all RRs against Channeling spells.
@@ 25
As Channeling Resistance, except is only effective against Essence spells.
@@ 30
As Channeling Resistance, except is only effective against Mentalism spells.
@@ 50
As Channeling Resistance, except is effective against all three realms.
